items.title: 20.3 Comparison of Reactivity of Benzene with Alkanes and Alkenes (benzene, alkanes aur alkenes ki reactivity ka comparison) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.3 with Quick Check 20.3 answered, printed page 61.

blocks.text: Alkanes aam taur par kam reactive (kam react karne wale) organic compounds hain, kyun ke yeh non-polar hain aur in mein sirf sigma bonds hain. Phir bhi UV roshni mein yeh kaafi aasani se free radical substitution reactions karte hain. Doosri taraf alkenes bohat reactive hain, kyun ke in mein π bond hai aur is ke π electrons electrophilic reagents (electrons ke shauqeen reagents) ke liye mojood hain. Alkenes aasani se electrophilic addition reactions karte hain.
Benzene mein teen π bonds hain, is liye ummeed ke mutabiq yeh bhi alkenes ki tarah electrophiles se react karta hai. Lekin electrophiles ke saath in ke reactions mein do bare farq hain:

items: benzene bohat stable hai, is liye kam reactive hai.
unlike (baraks) alkenes, yeh electrophilic substitution karta hai, electrophilic addition nahi:

blocks.alt: Left, electrophilic substitution: benzene (us ka H highlighted), arrow ke oopar Br2 aur neeche FeBr3, se bromobenzene + HBr; H ki jagah Br aa gaya. Right, electrophilic addition: cyclohexene jis ke double bond wale har carbon par H hai, Br2 ke saath 1,2-dibromocyclohexane deta hai, ab un dono carbons par H aur Br; double bond par do Br jur gaye.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki electrophilic substitution aur cyclohexene par electrophilic addition (kitab ke PDF page 64 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Benzene mein Br ek H ki jagah le leta hai aur aromatic ring bachi rehti hai (substitution). Cyclohexene mein do Br atoms double bond par jur jate hain (addition), aur ring mein double bond khatam ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab cyclohexene + Br₂ wale arrow par laal cross (X) lagati hai, jaise yeh reaction hota hi na ho.
Sahi: cyclohexene bromine se aasani se addition karta hai. Kitab ka matlab yeh hai ke benzene yeh addition nahi karta; is liye upar ki drawing mein arrow baghair cross ke bana hai.

blocks.caption: Bromine ka benzene aur cyclohexene se reaction
rows: Br₂ ke saath FeBr₃ (ya AlBr₃) catalyst
ring aromatic thi hi nahi; double bond khatam

blocks.text: Electrophilic substitution mein bromine ek hydrogen atom ki jagah leta hai. Is ki wajah aromatic ring ki stability hai, jo π electrons ki extensive (bohat zyada phaili hui) delocalization se aati hai. Reaction ek intermediate (beech mein banne wali cheez) se guzarta hai jis mein aromaticity toot jati hai, lekin reaction complete hone par wapas aa jati hai. Is liye electrophilic substitution benzene ring ki overall (kul) stability ko kharab nahi karti. Electrophilic addition mein delocalisation hamesha ke liye toot jati hai, is liye addition favourable (faidemand) nahi.

blocks.prompt: Benzene bohat unsaturated hai, phir bhi addition reactions pasand nahi karta. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Addition delocalised π system ko tor deta aur resonance energy (taqreeban 152 kJ mol⁻¹) waste (zaya) ho jati, is liye energy ke hisaab se yeh nuqsan ka sauda hai. Substitution mein aakhir mein ring ki aromaticity wapas aa jati hai, is liye benzene substitution karta hai.

items: Alkanes: kam reactive; UV roshni mein free radical substitution.
Benzene: stable; electrophilic substitution, jis mein aromatic ring bachi rehti hai.
